parameters.formDescription: Up to 3 seed keywords (or none). Collects Amazon's own suggestions: autocomplete for each seed, plus the related searches and shopping filters saved by every earlier search. Marks what you already screened, sets brand names aside, and gives you a ready-to-paste list for the Market Screener. Leave seeds empty to use saved suggestions only (0 searches).

parameters.content:
## i5 · Next Keywords
Seeds (optional) → Amazon autocomplete (1 search per seed) + related searches and shopping filters saved by every earlier search (free) → same-words ideas merged ("neck pillow travel" = "neck pillow for travel") → grouped: same product / nearby market / brand name → marked new or already screened → paste-ready list for i1. No AI.

## Brand names set aside
A word counts as a brand only if it leads its titles on your saved pages at least 60% of the time ("JOOLA…", "Lodge…"), or the product page named it. Generic words ("fabric", "hanging") sit mid-title, so they stay ideas.
